eligibility: completed explicit newbie chapter and its frozen role-specific successor active; matching school/map/NPC instance and authoritative interaction distance; current lease and connection generation

dialogue.opening: validated NPC visit authorizes the original local dialogue via active bean/state3 and SVisitNpc quest vector
dialogue.commit: matching original Start-tail CCommitScenarioQuest0xc4a44 with exact task/NPC and option0, validated current conversation ticket and role fences, persists choice authorization, then emits SPlayCardEffect0xc001c; task remains active and no weapon is granted yet
dialogue.dialogue_end: CQuestDialogEnd0xc4a52 belongs to original phase3 Finish cleanup; these Start-only first-master tasks end in phase2 and do not send it; it cannot authorize this card

choice.request: CGetCardItem0xc041f exact8-byte BE i32 effectID plus BE i32 itemID; no client quantity, task ID or nonce
choice.authorization: one frozen choice per role/source task; expected card and the two original item/quantity pairs; current epoch/generation/location version; do not derive a task or reward solely from request fields
choice.timeout_provenance: designed session authorization window, not a movie timer
choice.grant: exactly the selected original quantity, no other weapon, no automatic equip
choice.binding_provenance: designed bound starter equipment; card table does not define instance binding
choice.equipment_instance: reuse the inventory-owned ordinary instance factory and equipment-condition-v1 generation policy; retain raw baseEffect; item name colour is not an instance quality/score
choice.atomic_commit: chosen item instance and stable choice receipt, source type10 completion and common reward receipts, original type59 successor activation in one fenced role transaction
choice.retry: same committed choice acknowledges current state without another item; different item for the committed source task rejects; do not allow the second button to grant a second weapon
choice.full_bag_or_fault: roll back item/task/choice changes together; task stays active and choice recoverable
choice.disconnect_or_expiry: retain durable pending choice without granting/completing; a new valid visit to the same master reauthorizes original choices under the new session, never reset the task or silently select a default

equipment_objective.provenance: designed exact-received-instance predicate; original objective text says equip the master's weapon but target ID is zero
equipment_objective.predicate: asset owner confirms the same still-owned instance from the committed choice is actually equipped in its original weapon slot0; revalidate the current asset snapshot/revision in the caller transaction
equipment_objective.event: immutable role/item-key/template/slot/revision result of the public inventory equipment transaction; client CEquipement intent alone is insufficient
equipment_objective.atomic_commit: equip write, supported type59 completion and common receipts, and activation of its unique original cart-driver successor share the role transaction
equipment_objective.recovery: reconcile an already-equipped selected instance against the active type59 under the same lease/transaction; complete once, preserve current assets and later tasks
equipment_objective.non_evidence: no completion from item receipt, arbitrary equipment, NPC dialogue, targetID0, or virtual NPC10390; that link opens the client bag UI

acceptance: all43 task/card combinations load with two role-compatible original choices
wrong NPC, stale session/location, unsolicited choice and arbitrary item refuse
card choice plus task/next/asset receipt commit once and roll back together
same choice replay is harmless, second-choice replay refuses, bag-full remains recoverable
actual selected-instance equip alone satisfies type59, retry/reconnect cannot duplicate rewards
native connection message order and current bag/equipment refresh decode; actual GUI is separately authorized
